evidence: Order.advanceTo enforces that an order can only move to the next state in FLOW and throws DomainError otherwise. This is a pure business invariant, which belongs in the domain layer.
Order.cancel enforces that an order cannot be cancelled once it is shipped or later, or if it is already cancelled. This is a business rule and belongs in the domain layer.
The OrderState, FLOW and OrderLine declarations are plain domain types and constants, with no I/O, HTTP or storage concerns.
The file's only import is DomainError from ./errors, which is in the same domain layer. It has no infrastructure or framework dependencies.
